description: Creative coding in C# with DanaProcessing: create, run, live-code and export sketches, open the IDE's examples and the reference, from VS Code.
cmd.live: Run Sketch Live (applies edits while it runs)
cmd.makeRunnable: Make This Sketch Runnable (create its project)
config.packageVersion: Version of the `DanaProcessing.AvaloniaHost` package new sketches use. `1.*` is the newest 1.x.
config.dotnetPath: The `dotnet` command (full path if it isn't on the PATH). Sketches need the .NET 10 SDK.
config.idePath: Where the DanaProcessing IDE is installed, for **Open in the DanaProcessing IDE**. On Windows it can stay empty: the IDE registers its own link.
config.openProjectIn: Where a new sketch or example opens.
config.showStatusBar: Show the Run, Live and Stop buttons in the status bar.
config.referenceHover: When the mouse is over a DanaProcessing name, add a link to its page in the reference.
task.kind: run: run the sketch; live: run it and apply edits while it runs.
walk.title: Get started with DanaProcessing
walk.description: Sketches in C#: draw, animate and play with code, the Processing way.
walk.dotnet.title: Install .NET 10
walk.dotnet.description:
Sketches are .NET programs. Install the .NET 10 SDK, and the C# extension for completion and errors.
[Download .NET](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/10.0)
walk.create.title: Create a sketch or open an example
walk.create.description:
A sketch is a class with Setup() (runs once) and Draw() (runs every frame).
[New sketch](command:danaProcessing.newSketch)
[Open an example](command:danaProcessing.openExample)
walk.run.title: Run it, or run it live
walk.run.description:
▶ runs the sketch in its own window. ⚡ Live keeps it running and applies your edits as you save.
[Run](command:danaProcessing.run)
[Live](command:danaProcessing.live)
walk.share.title: Export and share
walk.share.description:
Export makes one file for Windows, macOS or Linux that runs without installing anything.
[Export](command:danaProcessing.export)
[Open the reference](command:danaProcessing.openReference)
